item.title: ABC News: NASA's Voyager 1 probe to reach historic light-day milestone today
item.description: Later today, Voyager 1 will have travelled more than 26 billion kilometres, one light-day away from Earth. It is the first human-made object to achieve such a milestone.

item.title: ABC News: Jensen Huang says he'd be 'honoured' to come back to Nvidia
item.description: It his first comments since resigning under pressure over his affair with a suspected Chinese spy, Jensen Huang says he "would be honoured" to return as Nvidia CEO if the board decides to have him back.

item.title: ABC News: US loses measles-free status after 26 years
item.description: Rising measles cases have coincided with declining immunisation rates and rising vaccine hesitancy under US Health Secretary Robert ​F Kennedy Jr.

item.title: ABC News: Trump praises Albanese as Quad unveils defence and minerals deals
item.description: With major talks in China approaching, US President Donald Trump, Anthony Albanese and their fellow Quad leaders deepen cooperation on defence and technology at a summit in Manila.

item.title: ABC News: Ukraine strikes major Crimean bridge as aerial attacks escalate
item.description: Ukrainian drones and missiles have struck a vital bridge linking Russia to the occupied Crimean Peninsula.

item.title: ABC News: Chalmers proposes rules to allow super to invest in housing, energy, startups
item.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers will unveil his long-awaited changes to the rules guiding what super funds can invest in, facilitating riskier investments with possible higher returns, such as startups.

item.title: ABC News: Alleged murderer thought he was being robbed during drug deal, jury told
item.description: An Adelaide man has given evidence in his murder trial, telling a jury he wanted to "get back" at a man who had swung a knife at him during an attempted drug deal.

item.title: ABC News: 11-year-old boy dies after being hit by car in Toowoomba
item.description: An 11-year-old boy has died after being struck by a car while riding a bicycle on a suburban street in Toowoomba, west of Brisbane.

item.title: ABC News: Alleged fugitive fires rifle in fight and crashes stolen car with passengers
item.description: A 24-year-old armed with a rifle has been arrested after allegedly firing a rifle in a fight, then crashing a stolen car, throwing three passengers from the vehicle's tray.

item.title: ABC News: Nine-month wait leaves Australia in a Cricket World Cup conundrum
item.description: Australia's series finale against England on Wednesday will be the team's last ODI until August next year, posing problems as they try to plan a Cricket World Cup title defence.

item.title: ABC News: Teenage boy fighting for life after being hit by car in Toowoomba
item.description: Police say a teenage boy has suffered life-threatening injuries after being hit by a car on a suburban street in Toowoomba.

item.title: ABC News: Queensland YouTuber brothers granted bail after police drug bust
item.description: Andrew Young and Stuart Douglas Blair Young were arrested in October following a three-month investigation into alleged drug trafficking across Toowoomba.

item.title: ABC News: Buses rerouted, stops closed during Story Bridge closure
item.description: If your bus crosses the Story Bridge, this is what you need to know for when the Brisbane landmark closes to traffic this summer holidays.

item.title: ABC News: Troubled NT university unveils new vice-chancellor following string of bungles
item.description: After a series of high-profile controversies this year, Charles Darwin University has appointed a new vice-chancellor and president, who says regaining the community's trust in the institution will be paramount.

item.title: ABC News: Twins' death after freebirth could have been avoided, inquest hears
item.description: An inquest into freebirth and homebirth deaths has heard that a woman's previous traumatic birth experience was behind her decision to shun antenatal care that could have detected her high-risk pregnancy.

item.title: ABC News: Aboriginal protester guilty of trespass despite 'cultural responsibility' to forests
item.description: An Aboriginal woman has been found guilty of trespass after a Hobart magistrate rejected her claim that she was innocent because she had a "cultural obligation" to protect forests from logging.
